_comment: Niv-Mizzet draw/damage loop through the DRAW STEP (GameEngine::DrawStep / the rollout's twin). Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind already wears Curiosity; the turn-5 draw-step draw pings (19), Curiosity draws off that damage, the drawn card pings, ... -- the shared iterative loop (ResolveDrawTriggers) runs until the opponent is dead, inside the draw step, before main 1. Library 40 Islands, so the 20 draws a 20-ping kill needs are there. If the draw-step flush or the Curiosity grant breaks, the win slips to combat or later and this fails.
